description: FCM push notification payloads for SILENCE. All notifications use FCM. Data payload includes screen destination and relevant IDs.

notifications.title: ✅ Membership Approved!
notifications.body_template: Approved! Seat {seat_label} at {library_name}. Starts {start_date}.
notifications.trigger: Admin approves join request
notifications.example: ✅ Membership Approved! Approved! Seat G-12 at Sunshine Library. Starts 25 May 2026.

notifications.title: Application Not Approved
notifications.body_template: Your application at {library_name} was not approved. Reason: {reason}.
notifications.trigger: Admin rejects join request with reason
notifications.example: Application Not Approved: Your application at Sunshine Library was not approved. Reason: No seats available.

notifications.title: Payment Confirmed
notifications.body_template: ₹{amount} confirmed at {library_name}. Plan: {start_date} to {end_date}. Seat: {seat_label}. Ref: {ref_id}.
notifications.trigger: Admin confirms payment (cash or UPI)
notifications.example: Payment Confirmed: ₹700 confirmed at Sunshine Library. Plan: 25 May 2026 to 24 June 2026. Seat: G-12. Ref: PY-4K9M2P.

notifications.title: Payment Not Confirmed
notifications.body_template: Your payment of ₹{amount} at {library_name} was not confirmed. Reason: {reason}. You can re-upload or contact library.
notifications.trigger: Admin rejects payment proof
notifications.example: Payment Not Confirmed: Your payment of ₹700 at Sunshine Library was not confirmed. Reason: Screenshot unreadable.

notifications.title: Plan Expires Soon
notifications.body_template: Your plan at {library_name} expires in {days} days. Tap to renew and keep your seat {seat_label}.
notifications.trigger: 7 days before membership expiry (9 AM)
notifications.example: Plan Expires Soon: Your plan at Sunshine Library expires in 7 days. Tap to renew and keep your seat G-12.

notifications.title: Plan Expires Today
notifications.body_template: Your plan at {library_name} expires today. Renew to keep your seat {seat_label}.
notifications.trigger: On expiry date at 9 AM
notifications.example: Plan Expires Today: Your plan at Sunshine Library expires today. Renew to keep your seat G-12.

notifications.title: Membership Expired
notifications.body_template: Your membership at {library_name} expired. Renew now – seat may be reassigned in 3 days.
notifications.trigger: Day after expiry at 9 AM
notifications.example: Membership Expired: Your membership at Sunshine Library expired. Renew now – seat may be reassigned in 3 days.

notifications.title: Application Expiring Soon
notifications.body_template: Your application at {library_name} will expire in 2 days. Contact library or reapply.
notifications.trigger: Day 5 after join request submission (9 AM)
notifications.example: Application Expiring Soon: Your application at Sunshine Library will expire in 2 days. Contact library or reapply.

notifications.title: Application Expired
notifications.body_template: Your application at {library_name} has expired. Contact library or reapply.
notifications.trigger: 7 days after submission with no admin action
notifications.example: Application Expired: Your application at Sunshine Library has expired. Contact library or reapply.

notifications.title: 🏆 Badge Earned!
notifications.body_template: You earned the {badge_name} badge! Check your Analytics.
notifications.trigger: Member meets badge criteria (7-day streak, early bird, etc.)
notifications.example: 🏆 Badge Earned! You earned the 7-Day Streak badge! Check your Analytics.

notifications.title: {library_name} Announcement
notifications.body_template: {message_preview}
notifications.trigger: Admin sends announcement
notifications.example: Sunshine Library Announcement: Library will be closed on Monday for maintenance.

notifications.title: Trial Ends Tomorrow
notifications.body_template: Your trial at {library_name} ends tomorrow. Pay to keep your seat and streak.
notifications.trigger: 1 day before trial ends at 9 AM
notifications.example: Trial Ends Tomorrow: Your trial at Sunshine Library ends tomorrow. Pay to keep your seat and streak.

notifications.title: Hold Request Approved
notifications.body_template: Your hold at {library_name} has been approved. Seat {seat_label} reserved until {end_date}. Expiry extended to {new_expiry}.
notifications.trigger: Admin approves hold request
notifications.example: Hold Request Approved: Your hold at Sunshine Library has been approved. Seat G-12 reserved until 30 June. Expiry extended to 25 July.

notifications.title: Hold Request Not Approved
notifications.body_template: Your hold request at {library_name} was not approved. Contact library for details.
notifications.trigger: Admin rejects hold request
notifications.example: Hold Request Not Approved: Your hold request at Sunshine Library was not approved. Contact library for details.

notifications.title: Hold Ending Soon
notifications.body_template: Your membership hold at {library_name} ends in 2 days. Resume studying!
notifications.trigger: 2 days before hold end date at 9 AM
notifications.example: Hold Ending Soon: Your membership hold at Sunshine Library ends in 2 days. Resume studying!

notifications.title: Hold Ended
notifications.body_template: Your hold at {library_name} has ended and seat has been released. You can rejoin to continue.
notifications.trigger: Hold end date passed and member did not check in within 3 days
notifications.example: Hold Ended: Your hold at Sunshine Library has ended and seat has been released. You can rejoin to continue.

notifications.title: Referral Reward Pending
notifications.body_template: Your reward for referring {friend_name} is pending – they need {checkins_left} more check-ins.
notifications.trigger: Referral friend joins, reward not yet released
notifications.example: Referral Reward Pending: Your reward for referring Rahul is pending – they need 3 more check-ins.

notifications.title: 🎁 Referral Reward Credited!
notifications.body_template: {days} free days added to your membership at {library_name} because {friend_name} completed their check-ins.
notifications.trigger: Referred member completes required check-ins/days
notifications.example: 🎁 Referral Reward Credited! 3 free days added to your membership at Sunshine Library because Rahul completed their check-ins.

notifications.title: Referral Reward Cancelled
notifications.body_template: The referral reward for {friend_name} was cancelled because they left the library.
notifications.trigger: Referred member exits before completing reward conditions
notifications.example: Referral Reward Cancelled: The referral reward for Rahul was cancelled because they left the library.

notifications.title: Renewal Offer Ready
notifications.body_template: {library_name} has prepared a renewal for you: {plan} at ₹{amount}. Tap to confirm or decline (24h).
notifications.trigger: Admin uses 'Notify Member First' renewal option
notifications.example: Renewal Offer Ready: Sunshine Library has prepared a renewal for you: Monthly at ₹700. Tap to confirm or decline (24h).

notifications.title: Membership Transferred
notifications.body_template: Your membership has been transferred from {from_library} to {to_library}. Seat: {seat_label}, Shift: {shift_name}.
notifications.trigger: Admin completes member transfer between libraries
notifications.example: Membership Transferred: Your membership has been transferred from City Library to Sunshine Library. Seat: G-12, Shift: Morning.

notifications.title: Library Closed Today
notifications.body_template: {library_name} is closed today ({reason}). Your streak is protected.
notifications.trigger: Admin taps 'Close Today'
notifications.example: Library Closed Today: Sunshine Library is closed today (maintenance). Your streak is protected.

notifications.title: Upcoming Library Closure
notifications.body_template: {library_name} will be closed from {start_date} to {end_date} for {reason}. Your streak is protected.
notifications.trigger: Admin creates scheduled closure (immediate or reminder)
notifications.example: Upcoming Library Closure: Sunshine Library will be closed from 20 Oct to 22 Oct for Diwali. Your streak is protected.

notifications.title: Manual Check-in Request
notifications.body_template: {member_name} couldn't scan at {library_name} – requesting manual check-in at {time}.
notifications.trigger: Member reports 2 failed scans, taps 'Contact Admin'
notifications.example: Manual Check-in Request: Rahul couldn't scan at Sunshine Library – requesting manual check-in at 09:15 AM.

notifications.title: New Join Application
notifications.body_template: New application from {member_name} at {library_name}.
notifications.trigger: Member submits join request
notifications.example: New Join Application: New application from Priya at Sunshine Library.

notifications.title: Payment Proof Submitted
notifications.body_template: {member_name} submitted ₹{amount} proof at {library_name}. Tap to confirm.
notifications.trigger: Member uploads UPI screenshot
notifications.example: Payment Proof Submitted: Priya submitted ₹700 proof at Sunshine Library. Tap to confirm.

notifications.title: ⚠️ Payment Proof Waiting 48 Hours
notifications.body_template: {member_name}'s payment proof for ₹{amount} at {library_name} has been waiting 48 hours. Review now.
notifications.trigger: 48 hours after payment proof submission with no admin action
notifications.example: ⚠️ Payment Proof Waiting 48 Hours: Priya's payment proof for ₹700 at Sunshine Library has been waiting 48 hours. Review now.

notifications.title: Member Exited
notifications.body_template: {member_name} exited {library_name}.
notifications.trigger: Member completes exit flow
notifications.example: Member Exited: Rahul exited Sunshine Library.

notifications.title: Seat Change Request
notifications.body_template: {member_name} requested a seat change at {library_name}. Reason: {reason}.
notifications.trigger: Member submits seat change request
notifications.example: Seat Change Request: Rahul requested a seat change at Sunshine Library. Reason: Need window seat.

notifications.title: Hold Request
notifications.body_template: {member_name} requested a hold at {library_name} from {start_date} to {end_date}. Reason: {reason}.
notifications.trigger: Member submits hold request
notifications.example: Hold Request: Rahul requested a hold at Sunshine Library from 1 June to 10 June. Reason: Exams.

notifications.title: Your Subscription Expires Soon
notifications.body_template: Your Silence subscription expires in {days} days. Renew to keep managing your library.
notifications.trigger: 7 days before subscription expiry
notifications.example: Your Subscription Expires Soon: Your Silence subscription expires in 7 days. Renew to keep managing your library.

notifications.title: Seat Auto-Held
notifications.body_template: {member_name}'s seat at {library_name} has been auto-held (expired {days} days ago).
notifications.trigger: Auto-hold trigger after expiry grace period
notifications.example: Seat Auto-Held: Rahul's seat at Sunshine Library has been auto-held (expired 3 days ago).

notifications.title: Member Referral
notifications.body_template: {referrer_name} referred {new_member_name} who just joined {library_name}. Reward {referrer_name} with free days?
notifications.trigger: New member joins using referral code (rewards disabled)
notifications.example: Member Referral: Rahul referred Priya who just joined Sunshine Library. Reward Rahul with free days?

notifications.title: Join Request Expires Tomorrow
notifications.body_template: {member_name}'s join request at {library_name} expires tomorrow. Approve or reject now.
notifications.trigger: 6 days after join request submission (9 AM)
notifications.example: Join Request Expires Tomorrow: Priya's join request at Sunshine Library expires tomorrow. Approve or reject now.

notifications.title: Seat in Maintenance >7 Days
notifications.body_template: Seat {seat_label} at {library_name} has been in maintenance for 7 days. Has it been fixed?
notifications.trigger: 7 days after marking seat maintenance
notifications.example: Seat in Maintenance >7 Days: Seat G-12 at Sunshine Library has been in maintenance for 7 days. Has it been fixed?

notifications.title: Overtime Check-out
notifications.body_template: {member_name} checked out {minutes} minutes after {shift_name} shift ended at {library_name}.
notifications.trigger: Member scans checkout after shift end
notifications.example: Overtime Check-out: Rahul checked out 25 minutes after Morning shift ended at Sunshine Library.

notifications.title: 🎖️ Library Verified!
notifications.body_template: Congratulations! {library_name} has earned the Verified badge. Your library now shows the verified tick.
notifications.trigger: Library meets all verified badge criteria
notifications.example: 🎖️ Library Verified! Congratulations! Sunshine Library has earned the Verified badge. Your library now shows the verified tick.

notifications.title: Offline Sync Requires Review
notifications.body_template: {member_name}'s scan from {date} couldn't be auto-verified (QR was regenerated or clock skew). Review needed.
notifications.trigger: Offline scan sync fails QR version check or clock skew >15 min
notifications.example: Offline Sync Requires Review: Rahul's scan from 24 May 2026 couldn't be auto-verified. Review needed.

notifications.title: QR Code Regenerated
notifications.body_template: {qr_type} QR for {library_name} was regenerated by {admin_name}. Old QR valid for 7 more days.
notifications.trigger: Admin regenerates QR code
notifications.example: QR Code Regenerated: Attendance QR for Sunshine Library was regenerated by Admin. Old QR valid for 7 more days.
